method: Agent editorial source comparison plus actual rendered/keyboard journey inspection and machine integrity checks. Not an independent expert rating or user study.

references.use: Adapt reader orientation, prose, progressive disclosure, fidelity, surface authority, evidence boundaries and role journeys. No full-profile conformance or numeric score claimed.
Adapt source/claim integrity, readable structure, canonical version and self-contained onboarding.

qualitative_criteria.name: Orientation
qualitative_criteria.acceptance: Opening identifies Riskium, its problem and published status before process details.

qualitative_criteria.name: Role journeys
qualitative_criteria.acceptance: Reviewer, domain specialist and integrator have ordered paths to relevant evidence and limitations.

qualitative_criteria.name: Natural technical prose
qualitative_criteria.acceptance: Sentences explain the subject; internal issue/stage labels do not dominate the main narrative.

qualitative_criteria.name: Progressive disclosure
qualitative_criteria.acceptance: Exact commits/hashes and process history remain available below the explanation in source records.

qualitative_criteria.name: Evidence fidelity
qualitative_criteria.acceptance: Historical results, partial/unexecuted scope, withdrawn claims, withheld cases and zero independent ratings remain distinct.

qualitative_criteria.name: Version intelligibility
qualitative_criteria.acceptance: Published source 0.3.5, semantic model 0.3.1, maintained documentation 0.4.1 and paper 7.0.8 have explicit different roles.

qualitative_criteria.name: Source authority
qualitative_criteria.acceptance: Wiki explains, Pages adds generated reference, and both lead to exact governed sources; four snapshots remain immutable.

qualitative_criteria.name: Reproduction usefulness
qualitative_criteria.acceptance: Reader can identify prerequisites, exact source, commands, expected outcomes and private-file/Git-history boundaries.

qualitative_criteria.name: Visual and keyboard reading
qualitative_criteria.acceptance: Inspect rendered entry, evaluation, reference and limits; headings, spacing, table overflow and keyboard access remain usable in the inspected environment.

qualitative_criteria.name: Cross-surface consistency
qualitative_criteria.acceptance: Actual active GitHub README, Wiki and Pages show the same released state and equivalent shared guide content.

limits: No controlled user study, independent human usability rating or semantic expert adjudication.
No unverified mobile or assistive-technology claim.
No submission readiness or new source-release scope inferred.
